name: What are the benefits of choosing composite deck boards?
description: Composite deck boards offer low maintenance, high durability, and diverse aesthetics. Higher initial cost but long-term savings are typical.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing composite deck boards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Composite deck boards offer several benefits, including low maintenance as they don't require staining or sealing, and high durability, resisting rot, insects, and splintering. They are also available in a wide range of colors and styles, often mimicking the look of natural wood. While the initial cost can be higher, their longevity and reduced maintenance can lead to long-term savings.
